name: Mairena del Aljarafe (Spain)
description: Green field with a broad white band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the arms of Mairena del Aljarafe (a tree on white within a yellow bordure inscribed AYUNTAMIENTO MAIRENA DEL ALJARAFE).
history: Municipal flag of Mairena del Aljarafe; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
